about_the_game:
❗LEGENDARY ARTIST ALERT ❗ Mizuryu Kei brings the heat with his stunning renderings of MOMOKA the stunning pink haired princess and her luscious M-cup milkers! 

The only thing that Momoka and Kenji have in common is that their parent’s legacies had a great impact on their public image. Momoka, the daughter of some industry big shot, appears to be the model image of a prim and proper lady, an ideal ojou-sama. While Kenji’s father operates a series of “adult goods” stores giving him the reputation of a player, a real casanova, he’s the guy his friends come to for advice about pleasing a girl cause why wouldn’t a guy who spends the evenings working at the sex shop know a thing or three about making chicks weak at the knees?

The masks they wear for their friends and family couldn’t be further from the truth! For one, Kenji hasn’t even hugged a girl let alone seen one naked (with no mosaics at least), he is a quintessential ‘cherry boy’ while Momoka’s secret, well… 

One night while covering a shift for his dad a peculiar guest comes in covered in a very conspicuous disguise and swipes a vibrator and sneaks into the women's bathroom. Before confronting this potentially dangerous shoplifter, Kenji does his due diligence and performs some reconnaissance by peeking into the lady’s room and who else does he see but the uptight, straight-laced Momoka! She’s straight up flicking it, she's bouncing on that vibe crazy style! 

Maybe this freak encounter is just what these two needed to connect and cast off the masks they put on for other people and start a relationship where they can be true to their authentic, sometimes degenerate, selves!

FEATURES

  • Translated version of the original Japanese Visual Novel

  • Momoka is fully voiced with original Japanese dialogue

  • Original artwork HD upscaled with 16:9 and 4:3 variants

  • Hours of story content

  • Audio, including music and special effects

  • Enhanced with animated character sprites

  • Gallery and Scene selections

  • Over 20 H-Scenes of educating this ojou-sama in ero-etiquette!

Secrets of a Porn Shop Princess is the English localization of a Visual Novel created by legendary Japanese developer Orcsoft. We at Cherry Kiss aim to provide an authentic Japanese Visual Novel experience to gamers outside of Japan.

**PLEASE NOTE**

All characters described and visually represented in this game are over 18 years of age, and no actual nor identifiable minor was used in the production of this game.
